meta.disclaimer: DEFAULT CHANNEL LIST ONLY. These are verified public Telegram channels used as the default scan set when TELEGRAM_CHANNELS is unset and no ?channel= is given. Every channel was verified live via t.me on 2026-11-03 (page resolves; title or redirect confirms existence). No channel names were guessed. The TELEGRAM_CHANNELS env var overrides this list when set.
meta.title: Default Telegram scan channels
meta.verification_rule: A channel is included only if https://t.me/s/<name> resolves to a real Telegram page (title or redirect) on 2026-11-03.
